deviations.description: 'Only touch parent entries (parent_doc == null/empty); never child chunk entries' (Phase 2 task 5)
deviations.reason: 15 of the 97 source directories (doets_1987, venema_1991, thomason_1984, burgess_1982, burgess_1982b, burgess_1984, derijke_1995, doets_1989, obendrauf_2024, reynolds_1992, reynolds_1994, venema_1997, venema_2001, verbrugge_2004, xu_1988) have a pre-existing, orthogonal index.json data gap: their children carry a parent_doc value with NO corresponding top-level id row at all (a phantom parent). Strictly honoring 'never touch child entries' would leave these directories permanently unstampable, so literature-search.sh's fail-open lookup would flag several of the plan's own named disclosed-partial benchmarks (doets_1987, venema_1991) as unverified_summary -- directly violating the plan's dominant acceptance criterion (zero false positives against the 5 disclosed partials). Resolution: entries are targeted by index.json .path prefix match against sources/<dir>/ (not by id-name matching); when at least one matched entry is a true root (no parent_doc), only roots are stamped (matches the plan exactly, ~82 of 97 dirs); when NO matched entry is a root, all matched child entries sharing the phantom parent_doc are stamped directly instead (the 15-directory fallback). This is documented in the auditor script's header comment and verified empirically: doets_1987 and venema_1991 both resolve to verified_conversion with zero false positives after this fallback.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — parent-only stamping relaxed to a path-prefix + root-detection-with-phantom-parent-fallback rule; see script header and progress approaches_tried for the 15-directory list)*
